title: Fixed Robot Scripts Schema
description: Schema for validating fixed robot path input JSON.

path.description: Array of movement or position configurations for the joint path.

target.description: An array of 6 numbers representing the target joint pose, in degrees.

ext_state.description: Optional. An array of 3 numbers representing an external state, in radians or meters

tool_status.description: Optional. A boolean indicating the status of a tool associated with the joint (e.g., on or off).

force.description: Optional. A numeric value representing the force applied or to be applied, in Newtons.

CNT.description: Optional. A numeric value between 0 and 100 representing the blending radius. This parameter controls the transition smoothness between consecutive path segments

RPM.description: Optional. Revolutions per minute of the joint or associated tool. Specifies the operational speed.

time.description: Optional. Specifies the duration, in miniseconds, for the robot to transition to this pose from the previous one. This defines the speed of the movement, with a lower value indicating a faster transition.

motion_type.description: Optional. Specifies the type of motion: 0 for joint motion, 1 for linear motion.
